kaveh.why: gav is cow in Persian - the clerk turns him into a cow

kourosh.why: kow reads as cow - the name of an emperor, spelled as livestock

sohrab.why: sharab is wine - forbidden, and now it is his legal name

arash.why: the space turns a hero's name into a skin complaint

omid.why: omid is hope in Persian; omit is to leave out

hossein.why: the double s collapses and it reads as hose in

ali.why: the back lane behind the shops

nader.why: nadir is the lowest point of anything

jamshid.why: a king's name becomes a shed for jam

parviz.why: the first syllable reads as perv

bahram.why: one letter and a war god becomes a bad ram

zahra.why: h and b transpose on a handwritten form

shirin.why: shirin is sweet; shiring is nothing at all

roya.why: roya is dream - the clerk upgrades her and erases her

mina.why: a myna is a bird that repeats what it hears

mohammad.why: ham is pork, which he does not eat, and now it is on his passport

ahmad.why: mad is in it, and it is on every form he will ever file

khalil.why: reads as kill at a border desk

bassam.why: bassam means smiling; bass is a fish

yousef.why: not misspelled - replaced with the English equivalent, which is worse

nawal.why: no wall - the one thing his life is entirely about

huda.why: huda is guidance; hooda is who-da

amal.why: amal is hope; a mall is a shopping centre

samir.why: the second syllable splits and he becomes an ear

abeer.why: alcohol, forbidden, printed on her identity card

ibrahim.why: the form splits it into three words and none of them are a name

farouk.why: reads as for rook, or as a bird

nour.why: nour is light; noor is nothing, and it is not even wrong enough to appeal

jihad.why: not misspelled at all - a perfectly ordinary name meaning effort, and every system in the world stops on it

osama.why: one letter, and the watchlist keeps both spellings

marwan.why: the a and the w collapse

wael.why: to wail is to cry out in grief

vongai.why: the form splits it and gives him a German particle

chidi.why: chidi is God exists; chidie ends in die

adebayo.why: a bayou, which is in Louisiana and not in Lagos

folake.why: fake is in the middle of it, on a document proving he is real

emeka.why: an Igbo Christian name spelled as Mecca

oluwaseun.why: not misspelled - truncated, because the field is eight characters

chukwuemeka.why: same field, same truncation, half a name

ifeoma.why: feo is ugly in Spanish, which the US clerk does speak

adaeze.why: a daze is what he is in by the fourth window

nnamdi.why: the double n is dropped as a typo, and it was the whole name

segun.why: see gun - and the system flags it, every single time

obiageli.why: shortened by a manager who could not be bothered

sunday.why: not misspelled - an extremely common Nigerian name that every Western form rejects as a day of the week

blessing.why: not misspelled - rejected by systems that do not believe it is a name

godswill.why: swill is what you feed pigs

oluwatobiloba.why: truncated at twelve characters, which is where the field ends

jose.why: the clerk hears Ho-say and writes Hose, which is a garden hose

jesus.why: not misspelled - an ordinary Mexican name that every American receptionist reads aloud as a joke

angel.why: two letters transpose and a name becomes geometry

refugio.why: a real and common Mexican name, and the clerk hears what he expects to hear

guadalupe.why: a loop, which is also what the paperwork is

concepcion.why: a medical event rather than a woman

dolores.why: dolores is sorrows; dolours is sorrows in English, and nobody meant to be that accurate

esperanza.why: esperanza is hope; one letter makes it despair

cuauhtemoc.why: truncated to four letters that read as cow

xochitl.why: the x defeats the clerk entirely

ignacio.why: ignore is now inside his name

rocio.why: the accent is dropped, then the rest of her is

alejandro.why: truncated one character from the end, which makes it wrong in a way nobody notices for years

maria jose.why: two names, one box, no space

garcia lopez.why: two surnames, one field - the standard Mexican naming system meets the standard American form

jhonny.why: not misspelled by anyone here - his parents spelled it that way, and he will explain it for the rest of his life

kyle.why: nothing happens - no clerk mishears it, no field truncates it, no officer asks him to spell it. This row exists so the difference is visible

priya.why: the one American in this list whose name does get rewritten, because it is not from here
